policy.statusMeaning: Presence in the March 2026 CRT AM dataset means the concession is in the current published universe described as vigente or en proceso de prorroga; it does not prove the transmitter is on air at this moment.
policy.identityRule: Exact CRT callsign + frequency. A single LMS facility is accepted. Multiple LMS facilities require a unique exact normalized CRT population/LMS city match; otherwise unresolved.
policy.rowCollapseRule: CRT rows are collapsed by folio_electronico + callsign + frequency because one concession may list multiple populations.
policy.plottingRule: Overlay selects existing LMS pattern IDs only. CRT values never replace LMS coordinates, power, DA/ND status, or geometry.
policy.patternSelectorRule: Resolve logical DAY and NIGHT independently. Prefer explicit LMS DAY/NIG records; use UNL only as a fallback. Within the chosen mode, select the pattern carrying the highest numeric MX_ application/file number. This is a conservative LMS-record selector heuristic, not a CRT engineering assertion.
policy.absenceRule: Absence from this CRT snapshot is not labeled inactive; such LMS records are simply not selected by this overlay.
